subject.title: fix(browser): keep Pro capture alive after CLI interruption

question: Should Oracle make detached worker ownership the supported default for every local Pro browser consultation, including commands using `--wait`?
rationale: The patch is a targeted resilience improvement, but it deliberately changes the process and session-lifecycle contract users observe during local Pro browser runs.

options.title: Adopt detached Pro workers
options.body: Accept the new local-Pro lifecycle so answer capture survives unexpected CLI termination while Ctrl-C remains an explicit cancellation.

options.title: Keep foreground ownership
options.body: Retain the current foreground browser controller model and seek a narrower recovery mechanism that does not change the default process topology.

recommendation.title: Adopt detached Pro workers
recommendation.body: Accept the new local-Pro lifecycle so answer capture survives unexpected CLI termination while Ctrl-C remains an explicit cancellation.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy and operational guidance concentrate on this Pro-browser workflow.
